D5/S3/Arith/Congruence/PadicObservationD.signature: theorem observation_distance_eq_padic_valuation (p : Nat) (x y : Int) (hp : p.Prime) (hxy : x ≠ y) : observationDistance p hp x y = (p : ℝ) ^ (-(padicValInt p (x - y) : Int))
